why: Today tile counts non-archived members with any live plan (homeTiles.ts:63, store.tsx:382); growth keeps archived and drops plans under MIN_TERM_DAYS=7 (businessGrowth.ts:54,199); both labelled 'Active members' with no note on the growth screen
MOVE_KEYS is cloud gym, branch keys, theme only (move.ts:23, hosts.js:144, public/move.js:7); LANG_KEY forgeai.lang.v1 (lang.ts:20) is never carried, so the new address falls back to English

Today uses WINBACK_WINDOW_DAYS=45 (membership.ts:481, Today.tsx:276,334) while the message group uses ENDED_WITHIN_DAYS=30 (audience.ts:35,41,66) and the assistant ended:30 (answer.ts:255); a member 31-45 days lapsed is on Today but not in the group

Cloud copy packs only own exercises (catalog_key IS NULL, copyLocal.ts:150-155) and pack.ts has no hidden or library-edit item, while the backup file collects both (backupCollect.ts:76-106); the card says everything comes back (accountWords.ts:16)

Score averages only the key lifts present, each divided by body weight (strength.ts:25-50), body weight falls back to the first weigh-in (analytics.ts:210); the card shows only the number and line with no reason for a drop (StrengthSection.tsx:42-70)

Beats are worked out once at last open (widgets.ts:382-396) and copied into every later day and the 52-week 'later' entry (widgets.ts:225-241, 91); Widgets.kt:199-207 shows 'later' beats with no age check, while progression.ts:672 cuts the weight after 6+ weeks

membershipView uses the answer's own a.day for days left and ended-or-not (membership.ts:151-162) and the kept answer is shown unchanged offline (MembershipCard.tsx:57); only the grey 'As of an earlier day' line warns (membership.ts:174-176)

Routine start saves workoutName null (activeWorkoutStore.ts:2009); finish screen and Health Connect fall back to the routine (finishSummary.ts:274-279, healthConnect.ts:242) but getWorkoutNames uses sessionTitle = title else day type (workoutNames.ts:20, finishSummary.ts:257-260) for History and the trainer (trainerSync.ts:161)

Headline counts each set once at its biggest picked share (statistics.ts:99-121, stats.tsx:173) while each bar sums every picked group's share (statistics.ts:248-249); the on-screen subtitle gives no hint of the difference

delete_session deletes the newest workout of a day straight away with no app-side confirm or undo (ai/tools.ts:1368-1373); the only guard is the AI prompt (ai/system.ts:48); latent because the coach tab is hidden (app/(tabs)/coach.tsx:32)

Live owner_send_message (0042:111-114) stores recipients counted at set time, while live owner_messages counts seen for anyone who joined before send_at (0025:750-751); no later migration redefines either

Live _challenge_checkin_days (0091:66-87, no later redefinition) gives no row for an unlinked or shared number, so the value is 0; the card text is a bare 'N of G visits' with no reason (boardWords.ts:95)

canLog blocks an empty weight only when there is no reps box (WatchLog.kt:213), so Done is live; the phone refuses a blank weight (setTick.ts:71-72, restDone.ts:298) and the watch then shows Not saved with the crossed phone and 'Log this set on your phone' (LogScreens.kt:752-763, MainActivity.kt:322/340), never 'add a weight'; the phone may post its own note

Error words come back as plain English strings (signin.ts:446-470, phoneCode.ts:53-62) and are shown raw in ErrorBanner {error} (SignInForms.tsx:130,336); GoOnlineCard has no t() at all and PinForms wraps only its two PIN labels (PinForms.tsx:38,47); hinglish.ts:11-12 scope omits these screens

'Send to their app' shows whenever server is on, no provider, fee, payRef and UPI ID (CollectOnline.tsx:220), with no check that the member is on the app; the member sees it only via mine() matching their roster id (pay.js:1295-1300), yet the sheet always says 'They see it under My membership' (CollectOnline.tsx:230)
